coordinator.title: Adopt reviewed base and fix combined integration regressions
coordinator.consumer: All seven development lanes start from the same preserved source base.
coordinator.acceptance: Verify base check receipt and six-commit map; repair demonstrated cross-lane failures in candidate; never replay prior prerequisites.

coordinator.title: Implement isolated original-profile capture and launch automation
coordinator.consumer: Scripts numeric probes, world lookup precedence, physics units and presentation camera comparisons.
coordinator.acceptance: Read effective executable/data/config profile; create separate test user-data roots and capture receipt. Prove original installation/saves/settings unchanged. If GUI launch cannot be isolated, record exact failing operation and finish independent trace/import automation.

coordinator.title: Wire persistent reference and pose consumers across crates
coordinator.consumer: Runtime reference state -> world lifecycle -> presentation; assets pose -> visible actor.
coordinator.acceptance: Implement only shared dependency/export/host wiring from contracts.json; jointly validate source identity, stale generation and save/restore. Lane owners implement their modules.

coordinator.title: Integrate small tested handoffs continuously
coordinator.consumer: A usable combined engine branch instead of seven unmerged stacks.
coordinator.acceptance: Read receipts, map commits once, resolve interfaces/conflicts, run changed-package checks. Publish exact development base immediately after combined validation; no checkpoint wait for dependencies.

coordinator.title: Freeze and prove a reviewed feature batch
coordinator.consumer: Reliable main promotion and honest public checkpoint.
coordinator.acceptance: Use new private frozen tree/target/evidence. Existing checkpoint45 verifier proves only its scope; add acceptance for new behavior, preserve old proofs. Review next batch in integration during long proof.

coordinator.title: Fix shared load/store failures on the selected player route
coordinator.consumer: Strict content store/index/source joins used by first source-driven route.
coordinator.acceptance: Reproduce a concrete failing dependency from worker diagnostics; fix within shared ownership with independent expectation, no blanket exception or second importer.

scripts.title: Build executable original/replacement microfixture trace runner
scripts.consumer: Existing prepared programs, native dispatch and local-copy execution.
scripts.acceptance: Use bounded original authored fixtures and real trace inputs for assignment/conversion/branch/GetItemCount. Altered trace must fail. Implement runner in Rust; native retail glue isolated and disclosed. Missing capture is blocked, never pass.

scripts.title: Capture one source-less original-script semantic
scripts.consumer: First faithful expression/native primitive through existing execution APIs.
scripts.acceptance: Pin exact profile and compiled fixture; capture caller, operand bits, return and event order in isolated profile. Share receipts without modifying retail install or normal saves.

scripts.title: Implement first-route execution capability admission
scripts.consumer: Prepared source plan used to enter Doc Mitchell/first Goodsprings route.
scripts.acceptance: Use existing winning scripts and plans to return exact first unsupported operation/context with source offsets; bounded dependency cycles and deterministic priority. No new whole-corpus parser, fabricated stage changes or no-ops.

scripts.title: Execute the first measured primitive end to end
scripts.consumer: Source-less bytecode -> canonical staged effect -> saved outcome.
scripts.acceptance: Match captured numeric/conversion/error cases; interruption does not acknowledge incomplete event or duplicate mutation.

scripts.title: Evaluate measured CTDA subject/group/comparison slice
scripts.consumer: Actor package and future dialogue selection through shared conditions.
scripts.acceptance: Reuse condition query adapter and exact source provenance; independently observed truth/group ordering, wrong-context cases and unsupported functions remain explicit.

scripts.title: Add resumable bounded execution with canonical commits
scripts.consumer: Measured route survives budget yield and cold Continue.
scripts.acceptance: Coordinate continuation schema with runtime; preserve current PC/context/locals and exactly-once effects, no invented retail schedule.

runtime.title: Reproduce and close remaining schema-invalid backup rotation
runtime.acceptance: Checksum-valid numeric-local replaced by reference null must fail source-bound validation before rotating valid previous. Preserve bytes on refusal, bounded validation context, cold restore and no silent recovery change.

runtime.title: Add canonical explicit reference transform/enable state
runtime.consumer: World cell residency and presentation snapshot adapter under REF-STATE contract.
runtime.acceptance: Persistent source identity, finite original-unit pose, explicit enable value, revision-checked mutation; same identity after unload/reload; no ECS IDs or fabricated initialization.

runtime.title: Expose save-ticket lifecycle for a real application consumer
runtime.consumer: Presentation save progress, errors and orderly host shutdown.
runtime.acceptance: Read-only nonblocking status adapter over existing SaveTicket worker; failed publication never displays saved; no duplicate writer/event journal or changed durability promises.

runtime.title: Persist and cold-restore reference state
runtime.consumer: Displayed source object keeps an explicit changed transform/enable state after restart.
runtime.acceptance: Versioned migration preserves existing saves; shared links before callbacks; exact headless/cold host state with preview consumer.

runtime.title: Add one consumer-backed actor or quest component
runtime.consumer: Actor rules or measured quest execution requests canonical state.
runtime.acceptance: Explicit field schema and evidence, atomic mutation and save/restore; add only fields exercised by named consumer, no guessed default actor values.

actors.title: Resolve actor render dependencies from winning records
actors.consumer: Presentation selected placed actor -> skeleton/body/equipment resource requests.
actors.acceptance: Reuse existing actor manifest, do not replace it. Add only missing model-role resolution demonstrated by chosen NPC/creature, source identity and explicit missing/ambiguous assets; installed and authored cases.

actors.title: Build authored package eligibility requests for live context
actors.consumer: Existing PACK dependencies -> scripts condition-query adapter.
actors.acceptance: Preserve authored package order and exact CTDA context requests without deciding unmeasured truth/schedule. Reachable headless consumer; no private CTDA or embedded-script parser.

actors.title: Implement bounded template dependency selection for chosen actor
actors.consumer: First visible actor initialization receives exact field origins.
actors.acceptance: Find current closure first; extend only missing TPLT/category selection grounded in pinned source or measurement; cycles/missing winners precise. Unproven inheritance stays unsupported, not defaulted.

actors.title: Initialize one measured actor state through canonical APIs
actors.consumer: Visible actor rules with persistent state, not inspector-only roster.
actors.acceptance: Measure chosen fields; use runtime state contract, source->rules->state->save test; no second mutable World.

actors.title: Connect one authored travel package to navigation
actors.consumer: Selected actor requests path/movement through physics and world residency.
actors.acceptance: Observed package conditions/order, supported route failure and interrupt behavior; no generic behavior tree replacement.

actors.title: Implement one measured combat/item rule used by route
actors.consumer: Actual player/enemy encounter and equipment, after required state/query inputs exist.
actors.acceptance: Pinned formula/rounding thresholds, explicit unsupported modifiers and source record provenance; no guessed damage constants.

assets.title: Deliver bind-pose and palette evaluator to presentation
assets.consumer: Existing decoded skin/source forest becomes selected actor geometry.
assets.acceptance: Reuse ASSET06/09. Bounded skeleton mapping and hierarchy transforms, authored independent numeric fixtures; reject unresolved ancestry/weights, never normalize or invent bind transforms silently.

assets.title: Cover the next actual first-person or creature asset gap
assets.consumer: Actor-selected missing asset capability in the same pose consumer.
assets.acceptance: Select input from existing manifest/census, inspect pinned format, implement bounded required branch and independent comparison. Do not repeat whole corpus inventories.

assets.title: Connect explicit-time channels to a bounded pose request
assets.acceptance: Existing sampler with exact source/controller links, explicit finite time and raw quaternion contract; independent pose expectation. Separate engineering sample from faithful playback/events.

assets.title: Implement first measured animation transition/event
assets.consumer: Presentation playback and actor action event consumer.
assets.acceptance: Capture clip/controller boundary timing, interrupt/repeat behavior, source annotations and tolerances; unsupported graph remains explicit.

assets.title: Add equipment attachment and rig coverage
assets.consumer: Actor equipment produces correct visible attachment across pose changes.
assets.acceptance: Identity-bound attachment transforms, first/third person cases and missing bones; saved authority stays with runtime.

world.title: Connect existing jobs to bounded cell residency lifecycle
world.consumer: Presentation requests scene data; physics reports readiness; runtime owns persistent instances.
world.acceptance: Explicit IO/decode/dependency/render/unload stages, generation rejection, bounded memory/pins and unload/retry. Simulation-ready requires collision; no second cache/importer.

world.title: Implement profile-bound lookup precedence from evidence
world.consumer: Real model/texture resolution used by scene preparation.
world.acceptance: Reuse explicit-root source evidence. Capture effective profile/order or pinned justified behavior for loose/archive collisions; deterministic fixtures and actionable ambiguity. No blanket last-wins.

world.title: Close one documented strict-source admission exception
world.consumer: M1 source corpus loading with exact retained provenance.
world.acceptance: Investigate known LAND/two archive mismatches using retained independent outputs, then original handling. World may implement verified digest-scoped archive.rs changes; shared LAND/plugin/store policy fixes go to V3-COORD-06 with exact reproduction/evidence. Otherwise preserve strict refusal and take another ready task.

world.title: Resolve original door destination and cell transition plan
world.consumer: Player-requested interior/exterior transition with exact reference identity.
world.acceptance: Source-selected links and orientation, bounded missing/cycle diagnostics; connect residency/collision/explicit state, no teleport claim for unsupported script effects.

world.title: Connect winning dialogue sources to conversation requests
world.consumer: Presentation original dialogue UI -> scripts conditions/result fragments.
world.acceptance: Reuse existing narrative/dialogue-membership parsers; enumerate source ordering uncertainty and actual voice/subtitle paths; no authored topic substitution or hardcoded quest.

world.title: Implement persistent loaded/unloaded cell transitions
world.consumer: One supported house/exterior route retains explicit source object changes.
world.acceptance: Use STATE04 snapshot consumer and PHYS04 readiness, stale completion and cold resume tested; faithful traversal only after measured units/activation.

presentation.title: Fix finite camera overflow and add input action boundaries
presentation.acceptance: Reject overflowing/zero source look direction before Bevy fallback; mouse/keyboard/controller, focus loss/disconnect and held-action leakage. Use pinned Bevy API, headless action tests and separate manual feel check.

presentation.title: Implement selected source pose consumer
presentation.consumer: Transferred WORLD03C proposal and existing ASSET06/09 sampling.
presentation.acceptance: Explicit finite source-time request, correct source link selection, bounded hierarchy assembly; begin currently supported channels, add ASSET01 palette when available. Preserve unsupported branches, no retail animation claim.

presentation.title: Open responsive window while preparing source scene
presentation.consumer: Existing startup progress and world resource jobs.
presentation.acceptance: Window/status appears before costly preparation, loading/error/cancel visible, GPU upload bounded and stale generation discarded; working terrain/material fixtures preserved.

presentation.title: Display canonical reference snapshots and save status
presentation.consumer: STATE02/03 adapters -> actual host render/input/Continue surface.
presentation.acceptance: Rendering never mutates canonical storage, stable identity across unload; completed/failed save truthful and source-defined view state after cold restart.

presentation.title: Implement first original XML/tile menu slice
presentation.consumer: Source-defined menu input/visibility/text consumer, then dialogue and inventory.
presentation.acceptance: Read actual template/operator/font inputs, bounded graph invalidation and explicit unsupported operators; independent source/operator fixture; debug widgets cannot claim original UI.

presentation.title: Resolve and play one original dialogue/audio path
presentation.acceptance: Codec/provenance audit, explicit localization/priority and measured timing; actual local cue, missing file clear, raw voice stays local.

physics.title: Turn existing collision shapes into a bounded static query scene
physics.consumer: Headless house ray/overlap query and later preview movement.
physics.acceptance: Use existing 16-type decoder and authored shapes, no visual-mesh stand-ins. Explicit engineering unit transform, measured faithful units remain gated; analytic shape fixtures, shared DAG, source IDs and budgets.

physics.title: Implement needed collision transform/filter source branch
physics.consumer: PHYS01 selected house body conversion and exact unsupported diagnosis.
physics.acceptance: Choose actual missing branch from existing corpus, inspect pinned source, preserve body/shape transforms and filter bits; independent known geometry including finite/degenerate/reflection cases.

physics.title: Load source navigation into bounded route queries
physics.consumer: Headless selected cell path request -> later authored actor travel.
physics.acceptance: Verify NAVM/NAVI layouts at pinned source, preserve triangles/doors/special links and missing neighbors; indexed graph/A* with justified heuristic and authored unreachable/cycle tests; no fabricated navmesh.

physics.title: Publish collision readiness and release by cell generation
physics.consumer: World lifecycle cannot activate missing collision.
physics.acceptance: Consume generation-tagged source batches, reject stale results, release own resources on unload, return exact unsupported capability; no parallel authoritative entity state.

physics.title: Implement measured character sweep/step movement
physics.consumer: Presentation movement intent -> collision query -> runtime transform.
physics.acceptance: Measure original units/step/slope/contact with isolated fixtures; bounded iterations, walls/steps/doorway tests and no silent teleport or penetration fix.

physics.title: Connect authored route to actor movement
physics.consumer: ACT05 package travel through real cell links.
physics.acceptance: Portal/special-link preservation, appropriate funnel only on valid corridors, explicit unreachable paths and dynamic obstacle behavior.

selection: Smallest ready task or a ready independent fallback; no per-task grant. Completed task IDs are recorded in worker status/outbox. Never repeat a completed ticket from this seed list.
